Method of Attack: Network scanning and information stealing to enumerate users and computers in a domain, gathering information about security, backup, and remote administration software, saving data in CSV files, compressing into ZIP archive, and exfiltrating to C2 server
Interacting with Volume Shadow Copy Service (VSS) via API calls using AlphaVSS .NET library to steal files from existing shadow volume copies even when files are in use by applications
Impacted Systems: Compromised networks with Windows systems using Volume Shadow Copy Service
Systems running anti-virus, security programs, EDR suites, backup tools, remote administration tools, common office applications, and DirectX
Attack Vector: Use of custom .NET tools deployed on compromised systems to enumerate network and steal files
Bypassing locked files by copying from Volume Shadow Copy Service
